<!-- One widget per pull request. -->

## What is it

A sentence about what the widget shows.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] `widget.json` is filled in, and `name` matches the folder
- [ ] `README.md` says what it runs, what it fetches, and anything it needs installed
- [ ] `preview.png` is cropped to the widget and under 500KB
- [ ] No API keys, tokens or personal paths in the source
- [ ] The code is mine to give

## Anything else

Commands it shells out to, endpoints it calls, or anything a reviewer should know.
